author: claude
summary: Owner report: clicking 'Queue All' on a ~1000-segment chapter took ~18s before POST /api/processing_queue returned a queue_id, and nothing appeared in the queue/TTS logs until then. Root cause: app/api/routers/generation.py's _engines_for_profiles() iterated all ~1000 per-segment profile names and called resolve_profile_engine(profile_name, ...) on every iteration, deduping only on the *result* (engine_id) rather than the input profile_name. Since a chapter typically uses only 1-5 distinct voice profiles, this meant ~1000 redundant calls to resolve_profile_engine, each of which does real disk I/O (state.json read+parse via get_settings(), a voice-profile-dir scan, and a profile.json open+parse) synchronously inside the request handler before the response was sent -- an N+1 disk-I/O stall (~18ms/segment x 1000 segments = ~18s), not synthesis time.

files.change: _engines_for_profiles() now dedupes on profile_name (seen_profiles) before calling resolve_profile_engine, in addition to the existing dedupe on engine_id (seen_engines) for the returned engine list. Collapses ~1000 calls down to the number of distinct profiles actually used.

FOLLOW-UP (same session, after owner reported the fix only reduced 18s to 11.34s): resolve_tts_engine_for_profiles() had the identical N+1 bug at a second call site -- its generator expression called resolve_profile_engine(profile_name, fallback) once per item in profile_names *before* the surrounding set comprehension deduped the results, so all ~1000 segments still triggered the disk-I/O-heavy resolve call. Now builds `distinct_profiles = set(profile_names)` first and iterates that instead.
Added test_engines_for_profiles_resolves_each_distinct_profile_once: 1000 profile names all the same value, asserts resolve_profile_engine is called exactly once.

Added test_resolve_tts_engine_for_profiles_resolves_each_distinct_profile_once: 1000 profile names all the same value, asserts resolve_profile_engine is called at most twice (once for default_profile's fallback resolution, once for the distinct profile).

revert_checked: Reverted the dedupe-on-profile_name change (git stash on just generation.py): new test failed with 1000 calls instead of 1, matching the reported symptom. Restored the fix; test passes. Same revert-check repeated for voice_engines.py: reverting produced 1001 calls instead of <=2 on the new test, confirming it exercised the same bug class at a second site.
sibling_verification: Ran tests/engines/ + tests/api/test_api_generation.py (427 tests) -- all green.
not_investigated: Secondary, smaller contributors noted but not fixed this session: get_chapter_segments() is called twice per queue submission (redundant O(n) rebuild of chunk groups), and get_settings() re-reads/re-parses the whole state.json on every call with no in-process caching -- both add constant-factor cost on top of the N+1 fixed here but were not the dominant cause of the 18s.
